---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable, responsive role-playing game about learning to be the oldest sibling, with a customizable family setup and a five-day story.

## Requirements
- At the beginning, allow choices for home location, household members, number of siblings, and each sibling’s name, age, and gender.
- Also allow choices for the player’s name, age, and gender.
- Provide a cozy visual style and playable choice-based family scenarios.

## Decisions
- Used a warm illustrated living-room aesthetic with a multi-step family setup.
- Made the game span five days with three choices per scenario.
- Tracked family bond, patience, energy, joy, sibling relationships, and a journal.
- Used reasonable defaults: Maya, age 14, two younger siblings, a leafy suburb, and Mom and Dad.

## Work State
### Completed
- Built `index.html` with full setup, responsive gameplay, five story events, choices, stats, sibling profiles, journal, family details, restart flow, and ending summaries.
- Added custom family setup support for up to five siblings.
- Verified JavaScript syntax.
- Installed Chromium and ran a browser smoke test.
- Confirmed setup submission transitions successfully into the game view.

### Active
- (none)

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Play through all five days and test the ending and restart flows.
2. Test the layout at mobile viewport widths.
3. Resolve any browser-console or visual issues found during the full playthrough.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Complete game implementation.

## Important Context
- The local development server was left running on port `3002`.
- A setup screenshot was saved at `screenshots/setup.jpg`.
- Browser testing confirmed the setup-to-game transition after adding form field `name` attributes.
